## Summary

[Partial] Ensure drain plug has Teflon tape, then pour fluid until it reaches the fill line or overflows slightly. [t2125]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Ensure the drain plug is installed with Teflon tape for a solid seal.
2. [Partial] Pour fresh fluid into the differential until it reaches the fill line or overflows slightly.

_Procedure reported by [t2125]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-lokk-and-drop-your-front-diff-front-lokka-and-diff-drop-bushings-install.4679/>_

## Specifications

- **Differential Fluid Capacity (Imperial)**: 1.85 quarts [t2125] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Differential Fluid Capacity (Metric)**: 1.75 liters [t2125] ([Unverified] single report)
